newsitem.title: USA: CapStar buys Westchase Hilton in Houston.
newsitem.headline: CapStar buys Westchase Hilton in Houston.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co said on Tuesday it had signed an agreement to acquire the 295-room Westchase Hilton in Houston, Texas, from Redstone Group.
Capstar said the hotel will be its 11th acquisition since its August 1996 IPO and will be the company's second acquisition in the Houston market in the past four months.
The transaction is expected to be completed within 30 days, subject to customary documentation and conditions, the company said.
"We were able to purchase this hotel at an attractive discount to replacement cost," said Paul Whetsell, president and CEO of CapStar, without disclosing terms.

"We continue to encounter a substantial number of first-class, full-service properties priced below replacement cost, despite an increasingly competitive acquisition market. We are aggressively seeking other acquisition opportunities and hotel management contracts to continue CapStar's growth."
